com.wac.autocore.ui.components

Class BookingScheduleField

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.wac.autocore.ui.components.BookingScheduleField

  • public class BookingScheduleField
extends java.lang.Object
    The date, the start time and the end time in the booking form. The calendar greys out days that cannot hold the whole job, and the time list shows free times only.
